title: S.U.P.E.R.M.A.N. (com.macjutsu.super)
description: Managed preferences for super 5.1.x, the open-source macOS update workflow by Kevin White (Apache-2.0, github.com/Macjutsu/super). Leave fields empty to use super's defaults. Credentials are never set by profile.

InstallMacOSMajorUpgrades.title: Allow major macOS upgrades
InstallMacOSMajorUpgrades.description: Let super upgrade to a new major macOS version, not only install minor updates.

InstallMacOSMajorVersionTarget.title: Major version target
InstallMacOSMajorVersionTarget.description: Highest major macOS version super may upgrade to, e.g. 26.

InstallNonSystemUpdatesWithoutRestarting.title: Install non-system updates without restarting
InstallNonSystemUpdatesWithoutRestarting.description: Install Safari and other non-system updates without a restart.

InstallRapidSecurityResponses.title: Install Rapid Security Responses
InstallRapidSecurityResponses.description: Also install Background Security Improvement / RSR updates (5.1).

WorkflowInstallNow.title: Install now
WorkflowInstallNow.description: Skip deferrals and install as soon as possible.

WorkflowOnlyDownload.title: Only download
WorkflowOnlyDownload.description: Download updates but never install them.

WorkflowRequireActiveUser.title: Require an active user
WorkflowRequireActiveUser.description: Only run the workflow when a user is logged in.

WorkflowRestartWithoutUpdates.title: Restart even without updates
WorkflowRestartWithoutUpdates.description: Restart the Mac at the end of the workflow even when no updates were installed.

WorkflowDisableRelaunch.title: Disable automatic relaunch
WorkflowDisableRelaunch.description: Do not relaunch super automatically after it finishes.

DeferralTimerDefault.title: Default deferral (minutes)
DeferralTimerDefault.description: How long a deferral lasts when the user does not pick one. (super stores numbers as text.)

DeferralTimerMenu.title: Deferral menu (minutes)
DeferralTimerMenu.description: Comma-separated deferral choices offered to the user, e.g. 60,240,1440.

DeferralTimerFocus.title: Focus deferral (minutes)
DeferralTimerFocus.description: Automatic deferral while the user is in a Focus / Do Not Disturb mode. (super stores numbers as text.)

DeferralTimerError.title: Error deferral (minutes)
DeferralTimerError.description: Wait time after an error before trying again. (super stores numbers as text.)

DeferralTimerWorkflowRelaunch.title: Relaunch interval (minutes)
DeferralTimerWorkflowRelaunch.description: How often super relaunches to re-check. (super stores numbers as text.)

ScheduleWorkflowActive.title: Maintenance windows
ScheduleWorkflowActive.description: When the workflow may run, as DAY:hh:mm-hh:mm entries separated by commas, e.g. MON:09:00-17:00,TUE:09:00-17:00.

ScheduleDeferredStartDays.title: Delay start (days)
ScheduleDeferredStartDays.description: Days to wait after an update is released before starting. (super stores numbers as text.)

ScheduleZeroDateManual.title: Manual zero date
ScheduleZeroDateManual.description: Fixed start date for day-based deadlines (YYYY-MM-DD:hh:mm).

ScheduledInstallDays.title: Scheduled install after (days)
ScheduledInstallDays.description: Install automatically this many days after the zero date. (super stores numbers as text.)

ScheduledInstallUserChoice.title: Let the user choose the install time
ScheduledInstallUserChoice.description: Ask the user to schedule the installation.

ScheduledInstallReminder.title: Scheduled install reminders (minutes)
ScheduledInstallReminder.description: Comma-separated reminder times before a scheduled install.

DeadlineCountFocus.title: Focus deferral count deadline
DeadlineCountFocus.description: Number of Focus-mode deferrals allowed. (super stores numbers as text.)

DeadlineCountSoft.title: Soft deadline (deferral count)
DeadlineCountSoft.description: Deferrals allowed before super stops offering deferral. (super stores numbers as text.)

DeadlineCountHard.title: Hard deadline (deferral count)
DeadlineCountHard.description: Deferrals allowed before super installs and restarts without asking. (super stores numbers as text.)

DeadlineDaysFocus.title: Focus deadline (days)
DeadlineDaysFocus.description: Days after the zero date during which Focus mode can defer. (super stores numbers as text.)

DeadlineDaysSoft.title: Soft deadline (days)
DeadlineDaysSoft.description: Days after the zero date before deferral is no longer offered. (super stores numbers as text.)

DeadlineDaysHard.title: Hard deadline (days)
DeadlineDaysHard.description: Days after the zero date before a forced install and restart. (super stores numbers as text.)

DeadlineDateFocus.title: Focus deadline (date)
DeadlineDateFocus.description: Date after which Focus mode no longer defers (YYYY-MM-DD:hh:mm).

DeadlineDateSoft.title: Soft deadline (date)
DeadlineDateSoft.description: Date after which deferral is no longer offered (YYYY-MM-DD:hh:mm).

DeadlineDateHard.title: Hard deadline (date)
DeadlineDateHard.description: Date of the forced install and restart (YYYY-MM-DD:hh:mm).

DialogTimeoutDefault.title: Dialog timeout (seconds)
DialogTimeoutDefault.description: How long dialogs wait for the user before the default action. (super stores numbers as text.)

DialogTimeoutUserAuth.title: Authentication dialog timeout (seconds)
DialogTimeoutUserAuth.description: Timeout for the dialog asking for the user's password. (super stores numbers as text.)

DialogTimeoutSoftDeadline.title: Soft-deadline dialog timeout (seconds)
DialogTimeoutSoftDeadline.description: Timeout for the dialog shown at the soft deadline. (super stores numbers as text.)

DisplayIconFile.title: Dialog icon
DisplayIconFile.description: Path or URL of the icon shown in super's dialogs (5.1).

DisplaySilently.title: Run silently
DisplaySilently.description: When to suppress dialogs: comma-separated ALWAYS, DIALOG, DEADLINE, SCHEDULED, INSTALLNOW, ERROR.

DisplayHelpMessage.title: Show help message
DisplayHelpMessage.description: Show a help message in dialogs.

AuthMDMFailoverToUser.title: Fall back to user authentication
AuthMDMFailoverToUser.description: Ask the user for their password when automatic authentication is not possible (5.1).

TestMode.title: Test mode
TestMode.description: Run the workflow without installing anything (for trying out settings).

TestModeTimeout.title: Test mode timeout (seconds)
TestModeTimeout.description: How long test-mode dialogs stay up. (super stores numbers as text.)
